subject.title: fix: add exact and prefix skill search modes

question: Should ClawHub accept bounded `mode=prefix|exact` on `/api/v1/search` plus `clawhub search --prefix/--exact` as the stable registry-discovery surface for the linked issue?
rationale: This PR adds a new public CLI/API contract with a 200-result cap, while the linked request includes reliable enumeration and counting workflows that may require cursor pagination or a dedicated listing/filter endpoint.

options.title: Accept bounded search modes after proof
options.body: Merge this direction after a maintainer confirms the contract and the contributor posts real ClawHub/Convex API proof for prefix, exact, and invalid-mode behavior.

options.title: Require pageable registry listing
options.body: Ask for `/api/v1/skills` filters or a dedicated list mode with cursor pagination if complete namespace enumeration and counting are required.

options.title: Decline search expansion
options.body: Keep ranked search unchanged and leave the linked issue open for a different registry-discovery design.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded search modes after proof
recommendation.body: Merge this direction after a maintainer confirms the contract and the contributor posts real ClawHub/Convex API proof for prefix, exact, and invalid-mode behavior.
